# Synthetic fixture (mimicwarehouse `fixture` tier)

Everything under this directory is **synthetic** - generated by `mimicwarehouse.fixtures`
(EP-11 hosp, EP-12 icu) from a seed and hand-typed public vocabularies. It contains no
MIMIC-IV row, no MIMIC-IV value and no identifier: every id space has its own floor -
`subject_id` >= 90_000_000, `hadm_id` >= 91_000_000,
`stay_id` >= 92_000_000, event/row ids >= 93_000_000,
`caregiver_id` >= 93_900_000 - pairwise disjoint, so a wrong-key join
never matches (D-27 addendum, EP-169). Real MIMIC ids live in 10 000 000-39 999 999,
which the pre-commit guard `mwh guard` refuses (GOVERNANCE.md section 3, D-27). Real
`itemid`s / codes / drug names are dictionary values typed from public documentation,
not data.

The layout mirrors the raw PhysioNet tree so the loader can point at it:

```
mimic-iv-3.1/hosp/<table>.csv        22 mimiciv_hosp tables, contract order
mimic-iv-3.1/icu/<table>.csv         9 mimiciv_icu tables, contract order
manifest.json                   per file: sha256, bytes, rows, seed, generator version
```

31 CSVs in total. `icustays` is derived from the same ICU segments as
`transfers`, so the two agree; every icu event lies inside its stay; every icu `itemid`
is in `d_items` with the `linksto` of its table.

Regenerate (byte-identical for the same seed / spec / generator version):

```
uv run --group dev mwh fixtures build
# = mwh fixtures build --seed 2026 --subjects 120
```

`tests/ep/test_ep11.py` (hosp) and `tests/ep/test_ep12.py` (icu) fail if the committed
files drift from what the generator produces (`manifest.json` sha256s), so change the
generator and rebuild rather than editing a CSV by hand. Tests read the tree through
`mimicwarehouse.fixtures.catalog.build_fixture_catalog()` (in-memory DuckDB, contract
types) - the `fixture` pytest tier (see `tests/README.md`).

`manifest.json` pins the contract through `contract_schema_hash` (load-relevant facts
only: columns/types/nullability, keys, sort keys, time/partition/load metadata, foreign
keys, column maps); `contract_hash`, `python_version`, `numpy_version` and
`polars_version` are provenance, ignored by the drift tests - so a comment-only contract
edit needs no regeneration. Change protocol: `tests/README.md` section "Changing the
synthetic fixture". Concept coverage on this fixture: `COVERAGE.md` (hand-maintained).

License: MIT, like the code (the fixture is not derived from MIMIC-IV data; the
vocabularies are public code lists typed from documentation).
